items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Woody Herman, everybody offered me jobs.

ctx.x: like everybody in the country offered -- Basie offered me a job. And I said, why didn't you ever ask me before, for God's sake? And he said, "I couldn't afford to pay you." And I said, "you've offered me $100.00 a week more than Benny's playing me." He said, "I don't believe it." And I said, "That's right."
Woody Herman, everybody offered me jobs. But I determined to stay in town.
